note: decisions.yaml destination_platform.id must be a key here; the BOM pin is read from .hermes/pins.json pin_key so one fact has one home. An unknown id is admission BLOCK PLATFORM_UNKNOWN. The compat path keeps the legacy packages; bootstrap uses compat_mapping.

superseded_rules.note: MTA 8.2 rules whose condition or advice encodes a pre-Quarkus-3.9 artifact name. On this platform the same extension exists under its renamed id (Quarkus 3.9 migration guide: RESTEasy Reactive → Quarkus REST). Each row applies only while `requires_present` is a declared dependency of the destination pom; the work list reports the incident as superseded, never as mandatory (pilot v6, 2026-09-10: two of three remaining pom obligations were unsatisfiable by any pom edit).

springboot-web-to-quarkus-00010.reason: fires while io.quarkus:quarkus-spring-web is present and io.quarkus:quarkus-resteasy-reactive-jackson is absent; quarkus-rest-jackson is that extension under its Quarkus 3.9 name and the BOM manages only the new id

jakarta-jaxrs-to-quarkus-00010.reason: advises replacing jakarta.ws.rs:jakarta.ws.rs-api with io.quarkus:quarkus-resteasy-reactive; on this platform the API arrives transitively from quarkus-rest, the renamed extension, and the rule matches the resolved dependency, not a pom line
